_comment: The loops cover every builder. Every mutation here is a way for a Roadrunner to be built and then silently left on its old image - the exact failure spec section 8 exists to end. Run: ./scripts/mutation_test.py scripts/mutations/loops.json

mutations.name: a cmake board that is not on the bus is never flashed
scope 'all' overrides the cmake verdict
mutations.find: if scope != "all" and device["status"].needs_flash is not True:

mutations.name: a cmake type with nothing staged is skipped
a named type narrows the cmake selection too
the cmake board dict carries the staged uf2
flash_all selects cmake boards beside the others
update_all selects cmake boards beside the others
the panel row and the fleet selection share one verdict
mutations.find: for device in self._cmake_devices(payload, family, helper, rows):
mutations.replace: for device in self._cmake_devices(payload, family, None, rows):

mutations.name: a cmake type-level flash covers every serial it declares
mutations.find: for device_id in [serial] if serial is not None else entry.serials:
mutations.replace: for device_id in [serial] if serial is not None else entry.serials[:1]:

mutations.name: update-all sweeps every configured type
update-all names a cmake type it could not write
mutations.find:
if source.refuse_fleet_before_batch:

if False and source.refuse_fleet_before_batch:

flashing one type never runs every provider's validating load
mutations.find: targets, refused = source.select(c, name, serial, force)
